component.name: Power Display
component.summary: Match your screen to your power source

description.p: A high refresh rate is worth the battery it costs while you are plugged in, and rarely worth it once you are not. Power Display makes that trade automatically: pick a resolution, a refresh rate and a performance mode for each power state, and the switch happens the moment the charger goes in or comes out.

Settings are per monitor and are matched by make, model and serial, so an external display keeps its own configuration across unplugging and replugging. Changes are also reapplied when a monitor is connected and when the machine resumes from suspend.
It works on the display server you already run:

ul.li: wlroots compositors including Sway, Hyprland, river and Wayfire

description.p: Performance modes are handled by power-profiles-daemon or tuned-ppd, so no part of this needs root.
